title: cyrtopera chlorotica
intro: Cyrtopera chlorotica, commonly known as the green calumba, is a plant species in the family Menispermaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, and it has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Cyrtopera chlorotica include its ability to act as a diuretic, reducing fluid retention and alleviating symptoms of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
